column16: Blue = cost efficiency  (how expensive each lane is per mile on average)
orange = time efficiency (how long, on average, shipments from that lane take)

column17: If both bars are high → that lane is slow and expensive 😬
If both bars are low → that lane is fast and cost-efficient 🚀
If blue is high but orange is low → expensive but fast
If blue is low but orange is high → cheap but slow
